caption: The video showcases a white tabletop where two spired magnetic-ball tower sculptures stand on a circular base at the right, beside a gray plate holding two rows of disc magnets crossed by a wooden rail. A left hand in a gray sleeve steadies one dark ball near the left end of a short rail while the right hand lifts a second ball toward it. The hands hold the pair close, the right hand inching its ball toward the first. The view then shows a long diagonal rail spanning the array, hands withdrawn except a fingertip at the left, with a ball at each end. A ball released at the left rolls rightward along the rail, blurring as it passes the discs. Reaching the right end it meets the resting ball, leaving one ball on the rail and another on the white base near the left tower. The tower sculptures, magnet rows, and framing stay fixed throughout.
relations: Left hand steadies ball at rail end; right hand brings second ball toward it.
Released ball at left end of long rail rolls rightward past the disc magnets.
Rolling ball meeting resting ball at right end leaves one on rail, one on base.
Towers, magnet rows, and framing stay fixed while the ball travels the rail.
